user.title: Add a Calendar Sync
user.description: Choose a destination, then choose source calendars to sync in full and/or source calendars to filter by title.

data.copy_all_from: Sync every event from these calendar(s)
data.from_entities: Sync matching events from these calendar(s)
data.keywords: Match these words or phrases in the event title
data.ignore_event_if_title_starts_with: Do not sync events whose title starts with
data.days_to_sync_past: Days in the past to sync

data_description.copy_all_from: Every event from these source calendars is copied. Do not also select the same calendar under filtered sync.
data_description.from_entities: Only events whose title matches a word or phrase below are copied from these calendars.
data_description.keywords: Required when using filtered sync. Matching is case-insensitive and uses whole words/phrases in the event title only; descriptions are not searched.
data_description.ignore_event_if_title_starts_with: Applied before all other rules, to every source calendar. This prefix check is case-sensitive. For example, use ! to exclude !Private event.
data_description.days_to_sync: Copy the whole current day plus this many full calendar days ahead.
data_description.days_to_sync_past: Add this many complete calendar days before today. A value of 0 still includes all events from today.
data_description.sync_interval_minutes: How often the automatic sync runs. The default is 720 minutes (12 hours).

error.no_source_calendars_selected: Choose at least one source calendar to sync.
error.to_cannot_be_from: The destination calendar can't also be a source calendar.
error.calendar_in_both_sync_modes: Choose each source calendar in either full sync or filtered sync, not both.
error.keywords_required_for_matching_calendars: Add at least one title keyword or phrase for the filtered source calendars.

abort.already_configured: This calendar already has a Calendar Sync configured.

yaml_no_longer_supported.title: Calendar Sync does not support YAML configuration
yaml_no_longer_supported.description:
Calendar Sync is configured entirely through the UI.

Go to **Settings -> Devices & Services -> Add Integration -> Calendar Sync**.

sync.name: Sync now
sync.description: Triggers an immediate sync for one Calendar Sync entry, or all of them if none is specified.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: The config entry ID to sync. Leave empty to sync all configured entries.
